title: Refuse a triggers add for an unknown decision
action: Per D7 (issue 99). `fn add_record(` in verbs/triggers/mod.rs stores `truncate_chars_head(decision, 8)` with no lookup, so `--decision null` registers a trigger bound to nothing. Before any write, resolve the given id against the decisions store at the control root (`ctx.control`, the same root the trigger store uses): accept a full id or a unique prefix of at least 8 characters of an existing decision event id (active or archived — reuse the decisions read model, e.g. verbs/decisions read.rs helpers or decision_target_candidates in verbs_write.rs, never a second parser). An unknown id returns Err with `bee triggers add: --decision <id> names no decision in the store. FIX: pass the decision's store event id (8+ characters), not a CONTEXT D-label; find it with bee decisions search --text <words>.` and writes no file. Red first: in the test module of triggers/mod.rs (see `fn add_list_resolve_round_trip`) add a test that `add_record` with `null` refuses and leaves the triggers dir empty, and that a seeded decision id is accepted; adjust existing tests that add triggers so they seed a decision first. No code comments. If cargo fails to compile in a file outside your files list, a sibling cell is mid-edit: wait 60 seconds and re-run; never edit that file.

triggers add with a real decision id still registers the trigger
